corrections.reason: Both the printed glyph (4th-order ና with shorter left leg) and Classical Ge'ez 1st-person plural imperfect morphology ('እንዘ ናወርድ', matching L35) confirm 'ናወርድ'.
The printed character is 1st-order ከ ('ደከምን', Amharic 1st-person plural perfect 'we toiled/grew weary'), not 6th-order ክ.
The printed glyph has the shortened left leg of 4th-order ሃ ('እማልድሃለሁ'), which is also required by Amharic verb morphology.
The initial glyph is 1st-order አ without a 6th-order kink, forming the standard Amharic gerund 'አያይዞ' ('connecting/joining').
